content.value: Suppose, in a TCP connection, the receiver process is slow at data consumption. (11) [CO3] Eventually, the receiver buffer is full and the receiver advertises zero window size. The sender halts sending. Whenever the receiver process consumes a packet, receiver sends an acknowledgement to the sender. Sender sends the next packet. Will this result in a problem? If yes, discuss about the reasoning and a possible solution.
